# Portal Zoom

**Carry › Portal** · v1.0.0 · 42 frames at 30 fps (20–80)

A round window opens in the old scene showing the new one, and the camera flies into it.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/portal-zoom@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Diving into a screen, window or detail
- Worlds within worlds
- Openers

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import portalZoom from './transitions/08-carry/portal/portal-zoom';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(portalZoom, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 42 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | number | `0.79` | 0–1 | Portal centre x. |
| `y` | number | `0.5` | 0–1 | Portal centre y. |
| `radius` | number | `0.17` | 0.05–0.4 | Opening size of the portal, as a share of frame height. |
| `ring` | color | `"#F1EFEA"` |  | Colour of the portal rim. |
